tools.name: lookup_business
tools.description: Checks whether one specific dentist, eye doctor, vet, dermatology or GI practice is private-equity backed, from its name plus city and state or ZIP. A street address or phone number makes the match surer. Returns a status (match, multiple_matches, possible_matches, no_match, need_location), a "say"

tools.name: find_businesses
tools.description: List dentists, eye care practices, vets, dermatology or GI practices in a ZIP code, city or state, optionally filtered by ownership label. Covers requests like "dentists in Plano, TX with no PE ties" (label=no_known_pe_ties) or "PE-backed eye doctors in 75024" (label=pe_backed,lender_owned). Labels:

tools.name: get_group
tools.description: Get an owner group's ownership details: label and consumer wording, owner or PE backers and since when, PE stake (majority or minority), how it holds practices (buyout, partnership, joint venture, de novo), parent and brands, every source with its headline and date, and known locations by state.
